name: Enthalpy v0.4.7
notes:
# Enthalpy v0.4.7

## Fixed

- Includes the required time-zone definitions in the Windows application. A
  new or existing workspace now loads with a valid local time zone instead of
  showing “The time zone is not valid.”

## Preview limits

- Hosted Sync remains available only to the approved owner account on macOS
  Apple Silicon and Windows x64.
- Use only disposable test data until the independent protocol and cryptographic
  review is complete.
- Account creation stays invite-only with a hard one-account limit.
